skill.summary: This skill should be used when the user asks to "analyze competitors", "competitor SEO", "who ranks for", "competitive analysis", "what are my competitors do...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of the competitor-analysis skill:

- Provides in-depth competitor SEO and GEO analysis, including keyword rankings, content strategies, backlink profiles, and AI citation patterns.
- Reveals actionable opportunities to outperform competitors and includes templates for comprehensive reporting.
- Supports both automated data (via SEO tools) and manual input for flexibility.
- Includes guidance on identifying direct, indirect, and content competitors.
- Outlines step-by-step instructions for performing and structuring a full competitor analysis.
- Integrated with the broader SEO & GEO Skills Library for easy access to related skills.
